description: Defines the HttpAuthPreferences class which manages HTTP authentication preferences and settings, including default credentials, scheme allowances, and feature flags.

classes.name: HttpAuthPreferences
classes.description: Manages HTTP authentication preferences, including configuration options and feature flags.

methods.name: HttpAuthPreferences
methods.description: Constructor for HttpAuthPreferences.

methods.name: NegotiateDisableCnameLookup
methods.description: Returns whether CNAME lookup is disabled for negotiate.

methods.name: NegotiateEnablePort
methods.description: Returns whether port is enabled for negotiate.

methods.name: NtlmV2Enabled
methods.description: Returns whether NTLMv2 is enabled (POSIX/Fuchsia only).

methods.name: AuthAndroidNegotiateAccountType
methods.description: Returns the Android negotiate account type (Android only).

methods.name: AllowGssapiLibraryLoad
methods.description: Returns whether GSSAPI library loading is allowed (ChromeOS only).

methods.name: CanUseDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Determines if default credentials can be used for a given URL scheme and host.

methods.name: GetDelegationType
methods.description: Gets the delegation type for a given URL scheme and host.

methods.name: set_delegate_by_kdc_policy
methods.description: Sets whether to delegate by KDC policy.

methods.name: delegate_by_kdc_policy
methods.description: Returns whether delegation by KDC policy is enabled.

methods.name: set_negotiate_disable_cname_lookup
methods.description: Sets whether to disable CNAME lookup for negotiate.

methods.name: set_negotiate_enable_port
methods.description: Sets whether to enable port in negotiate.

methods.name: basic_over_http_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether Basic auth over HTTP is enabled.

methods.name: set_basic_over_http_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Basic auth over HTTP.

methods.name: set_ntlm_v2_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables NTLMv2 (POSIX/Fuchsia only).

methods.name: set_allow_gssapi_library_load
methods.description: Sets whether GSSAPI library load is allowed (ChromeOS only).

methods.name: allowed_schemes
methods.description: Returns the set of allowed schemes for authentication.

methods.name: set_allowed_schemes
methods.description: Sets the allowed schemes for authentication.

methods.name: set_http_auth_scheme_filter
methods.description: Sets a filter callback for HTTP auth schemes.

methods.name: IsAllowedToUseAllHttpAuthSchemes
methods.description: Checks if all HTTP auth schemes are allowed for a given URL.

methods.name: SetServerAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the server allowlist.

methods.name: SetDelegateAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the delegate allowlist.

methods.name: SetAllowDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Sets whether default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: set_auth_android_negotiate_account_type
methods.description: Sets the Android negotiate account type (Android only).
